evals.name: isolated-table-test
evals.prompt: Write a table-driven unit test for an email validator function covering valid and invalid formats.
evals.expected_output: Table-driven test with struct test cases, t.Run subtests, and clear failure assertions.
assertions: Uses table-driven structure (slice of test cases with name, input, expected).
Executes each test case inside t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) { ... }).
Tests edge cases (empty string, missing @, long domains) in isolation.

evals.name: mock-outbound-dependencies
evals.prompt: Test a user registration service in isolation by mocking its repository dependency.
evals.expected_output: Unit test using test doubles or mocks to simulate success and database failure scenarios.
assertions: Injects mock repository implementing UserRepository interface.
Tests business logic without spinning up real database or network listeners.
Verifies that usecase handles repository error and returns expected domain error.

evals.name: test-error-branches
evals.prompt: Ensure 100% branch coverage of error conditions in an HTTP handler.
evals.expected_output: Subtests for invalid JSON payload, validation error, service failure, and success response.
assertions: Tests malformed JSON body returns HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Tests validation failure returns HTTP 422 / 400 with details.
Tests internal service error returns HTTP 500.
